description: Use this after the customer supplies the six-digit SMS code from request_booking. It can create customer and job records or an office-review lead, notify the office, and send transactional customer or referral-status texts. Only status:confirmed with booked:true means the visit is scheduled. status:callback_pending with booked:false means the office must follow up and must never be described as an appointment. Replaying the same valid confirmation is safe and returns the stored result.

booking_id.description: The booking_id (UUID) returned by request_booking for this pending booking.

code.description: The 6-digit code the customer received by SMS after request_booking. Ask the customer for it; never guess or reuse a customer_lookup code.

name: confirm_booking
title: Confirm a Booking with the SMS Code
